note: zh 节日 means festival in general, not a legally set national holiday

changes.def_zh_standard: 法定假日；公休日 —— 国家法律规定的庆祝日

note: ja and zh standard join two senses (leading role and central person); reduced to the leading part

changes.def_ja_standard: 劇や映画などで中心となる役。
changes.def_en_standard: leading role; lead part — the central part in a play or film
changes.def_zh_standard: 主角 —— 戏剧、电影等中的中心角色

note: en uses the romanized source word; zh 将棋 is not natural Chinese (日本象棋)

changes.def_en_standard: Japanese chess — a board game in which players try to capture the opposing king
changes.def_zh_standard: 日本象棋 —— 在棋盘上移动棋子、将死对方王将的游戏

note: joins two senses (up and down / rising and falling); reduced to the single sense 'top and bottom'

changes.def_en_standard: up and down; top and bottom — above and below

note: en gloss uses the romanized source word 'shoji/shōji'

changes.def_en_standard: paper sliding door; paper screen — a wooden frame covered with paper
changes.def_zh_standard: 纸拉门 —— 木框上糊纸的日式拉门

note: draft restricts decimals to numbers less than one, which is wrong (e.g. 3.14); 小数 is a number written with a decimal point

changes.def_ja_simple: てんをつかってあらわすかず。
changes.def_ja_standard: 小数点を使って表した数。
changes.def_en_standard: decimal — a number written with a decimal point, such as 0.5
changes.def_zh_standard: 小数 —— 用小数点表示的数，如0.5

note: joins two senses (optical and center of attention); reduced to the figurative focus matching the simple definition

changes.def_ja_standard: 関心や注意が集中する中心の点。
changes.def_en_standard: focus; focal point — the center of attention or interest
changes.def_zh_standard: 焦点 —— 关注或讨论集中的中心

note: joins urine and the act of urinating; hint is the colloquial word for urine

changes.def_en_standard: urine; piss — informal word for urine
changes.def_zh_standard: 小便；尿 —— 口语中指尿液

note: zh 消防署 copies Japanese; natural Chinese is 消防站

changes.def_zh_standard: 消防站 —— 消防员驻守、出动救火救护的地方

note: joins two senses (front face / directly opposite); reduced to front

changes.def_ja_standard: 物の前に向いている面。
changes.def_en_standard: front; facade — the face of something that faces forward
changes.def_zh_standard: 正面 —— 物体朝前的一面

note: joins consumption and exhaustion of strength; reduced to using up

changes.def_en_standard: consumption; using up — spending a resource until it is depleted
changes.def_zh_standard: 消耗；耗费 —— 因使用而减少
